Hi Laura,

Thanks for taking my call earlier. Merchant Co is onboarding as a non-US vendor and we hit a couple of questions on the purchase order (PO) process and VAT handling for UK sales. Two specific asks: 1) Can Redwood accept invoices that use our UK office VAT number through a fiscal representative (we use BrightFiscal Ltd) and 2) what fields do you need on the invoice to ensure PO activation / payment in your system?

We would like to get a PO number linked to our UK entity rather than the US parent. I attached a copy of our VAT registration confirmation (Merchant_VAT_Registration_Scan.pdf) and can provide a letter of authorization from BrightFiscal if required.

Hi Alice — great to meet you earlier.

Summary and next steps I can action this week:
- We need a) VAT registration doc (you attached — thanks), b) a signed Letter of Appointment from BrightFiscal confirming they act as your fiscal representative, and c) the legal trading name and registered address for the UK billing entity (exactly as it should appear on the PO/invoice).
- For PO activation we require invoice fields: invoice number, invoice date, VAT registration number (UK), billing address (as on PO), bank details, and the PO number (we will send this after the vendor record is created).
- Please confirm whether Merchant Co wants invoices billed to the UK entity or billed to the US parent with tax reverse-charge handling. If you want the UK entity, we will enable PO routing to the UK billing entity and add BrightFiscal as the fiscal rep contact in the vendor profile.

Internal notes: Ben/Karthik — can procurement enable a UK-entity vendor record and accept fiscal rep documentation (letter + contact)? If yes, Ben, please advise whether we need a vendor form signed in addition to the LOA and whether we should request a certified translation for the LOA.

Alice — if you can send BrightFiscal's LOA and the exact billing address, I’ll start vendor creation and come back with a PO template for you to confirm.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Global Procurement
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Merchant Co — VAT representative and PO setup

Laura — quick internal response.

We can create a UK vendor entity and route POs to that entity once we have:
- VAT registration doc (good)
- Letter of Appointment from BrightFiscal (letter must be on BrightFiscal letterhead, signed, with the fiscal rep contact name/email and relationship dates)
- UK bank details and confirmation of beneficiary name
- Company registration number and registered address for anti-fraud checks

Procurement asks: please request BrightFiscal to include a short confirmation that they will accept legal service of process and hold documentation for tax authorities — we keep that on file for fiscal reps in the UK. If Merchant prefers invoices to the US parent with reverse-charge, we need a tax counsel sign-off — otherwise UK-entity invoicing is simpler.

I'll mark the vendor form as pending; if Merchant provides the LOA and bank stub we can complete vendor verification and issue a PO in 2-3 business days. Attaching the internal PO acceptance checklist for reference (Signed_PO_Template.docx).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
